reason: No owner is named Petrus Paulus. C02 Petrus Jacobus (sv Paul) shares only the first name, and his second name differs. C10 and C12 are Paul/Paulus Johannes, so their first name differs.
No De Beer owner bears the names Adriaan Carel. The Somerset candidates are Johannes Arnoldus, Johannes Matthys and Samuel Pieter, all clearly different given names.

No owner is named Willem Frederik. C15 Willem Jacobus (sv Pieter B.) and C20 Willem Christiaan share only the first name, with different second names. C20 is also in Graaff-Reinet rather than Somerset.
No owner is named Barend Willem Jacobus. C02 Jan Harmse is the man's recorded father, not him, and C01 is his brother Thomas Ignatius.
Neither owner matches Jacobus Petrus: the candidates are Johannes Stephanus and Petrus, both in Uitenhage. The first name differs and the district differs from Somerset-Oos.
The only owner, Johan Hendrik Breytenbach, has clearly different given names from Johannes Velter Coenraad Cornelis. He matches a different man (P0092).
No owner is Cornelis Johannes. C09 Cornelis Tobias shares only the first name with a different second name, which is weak evidence.
No owner is named Francois Arnoldus. C07 Thomas Arnoldus and C02/C05 Johannes/Jacobus Francois share only one name each, in a different position.
C01 Johan Hendrik Breytenbach matches the given names exactly and is in the same declared district, Uitenhage. He is the only Breytenbach candidate.
C03 Thomas Ignatius Steenkamp matches the given names and district (Somerset). His note 'sv Jan' agrees with the genealogy father, Jan Harmse Steenkamp.
